name: auto-advance
summary: Auto-rotate + auto-resume for Claude Code under rate/session limits — swaps to the freshest account, relaunches headless loops; interactive is swap-only.
install: curl -fsSL -o auto-advance.tar.gz https://github.com/primovera12/gnesis-vault/releases/latest/download/auto-advance.tar.gz && tar xzf auto-advance.tar.gz && cd auto-advance && bash install.sh
usage_prompt: Install auto-advance from the Gnesis Vault, then run /auto-advance start so autopilot auto-swaps accounts at the limit.
